subject: english
question: What does "bark" mean in: "The dog barked loudly at the stranger."

options.text: A loud sound made by a dog

solution:
**The correct answer is: Option 1) A loud sound made by a dog.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bark** in this context refers to the loud vocal sound made by a dog. (कुत्ते के भौंकने की आवाज़)

 
 
• **Example:** The dog barked loudly at the stranger.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **A loud sound made by a dog**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their meanings:

 
• **Outer part of a tree** (पेड़ की बाहरी परत): This refers to the outermost layers of stems and roots of woody plants.
 
• **A wooden texture** (लकड़ी की बनावट): This could refer to the appearance or feel of wood, although "bark" specifically refers to tree bark in this context.
 
• **A sharp command** (तीखा आदेश): This refers to a quick and harsh instruction, typically not related to the sound a dog makes.

4d:T8d4,

The correct answer is** option 1.**
